## The Sales Hiring Challenge

Every day without a full sales team is lost revenue. Traditional recruiting takes months, while your competitors capture market share and your pipeline dries up.

Sales candidates are notorious for inflating numbers. "President's Club" claims are hard to verify, and bad hires can poison team culture and waste 6 months of ramp time.

You need salespeople who can sell YOUR product to YOUR market. Generic sales talent rarely translates to immediate productivity in a new environment.

### The TaasFlow Solution

- Track record verification: we validate quota attainment claims and check references
- Industry-aligned talent: salespeople with experience selling to your target market
- Full-funnel coverage: SDRs, AEs, Account Managers, Sales Engineers, Leaders
- CRM proficiency: Salesforce, HubSpot, Outreach, and other sales tech experience
- Fast ramp: candidates selected for quick time-to-productivity in new environments
